recent_en: K-One Technology is proceeding with the RM94 million disposal of its entire equity interest in G-AsiaPacific to Itochu Singapore and Itochu Corporation, which was approved by shareholders at the EGM on 30 September 2026. The company also proposed a RM46 million capital reduction and repayment, and declared a single-tier special dividend of 5.6 sen per share. Latest quarterly revenue rose 41.4% QoQ with net income of RM433,000.
notable_en: Shareholders approved the disposal of the entire equity interest in G-AsiaPacific to Itochu Singapore and Itochu Corporation for RM94 million cash at the EGM.
Shareholders approved the proposed RM46 million capital reduction and repayment.
The company declared a single-tier special dividend of 5.6 sen per share, with ex-date on 4 December 2026 and payment date on 21 December 2026.
risks_en: The company proposed a RM46 million capital reduction and repayment, involving a reduction of issued share capital.
The special dividend amount may be adjusted for any new shares issued upon exercise of Warrants D before the entitlement date.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue was RM69.2 million, up 41.4% QoQ and 7.3% YoY; net income was RM433,000 with a net margin of 0.6%, turning positive from a net margin of -5.3% in the prior quarter, and net income rose 35.3% YoY.
